statement: The full comparative-efficiency planning candidate preserves both rejected artifacts and append-only verdicts, records the exact passing validation scope that excludes immutable patch archives, retains every corrected ownership and dependency contract, and passes independent SHA-256-bound verification.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Preserve both rejected diff artifacts and their hash-bound verifier findings byte-for-byte; correct the validation statement through new append-only evidence.
The landing candidate must contain the complete planning program, both predecessor Quest histories and artifacts, and this validation correction.
Validation must name and execute the exact scoped whitespace check that excludes immutable diff archives while checking all live planning bytes.
The same independent verifier must approve the SHA-256-bound full replacement diff before handoff.
